d: India is heading into a fresh tariff threat with some important strengths. The Sensex and Nifty have both gained more than 12% in November, foreign portfolio investors have returned in force, and the rupee has recovered sharply from its recent lows. India’s economy also grew 7.8% in the April–June quarter, keeping it among the fastest-growing major economies. But beneath that resilience are clear risks. Inflation pressures are widening.
